sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Surgery is a Practical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The ability to perform field surgery may save your life in critical situations. The better you learn this skill, the faster and better you will perform combat surgeries.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases surgery speed (0.4% per level → +20% at Elite Level)
- Reduces surgery HP penalty (1% per level → -50% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Increases surgery speed (+20% → +40% total)
- Elite level: Reduces surgery HP penalty (-50% → -100% total: Limbs are restored with full HP)

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- 1.1 points per use of a CMS surgical kit or Surv12 field surgical kit on a blacked out limb.
- Completing the quest Get a Foothold
- Completing the quest Profit Retention
- Completing the quest Beneath The Streets
- Completing the quest Crisis

sections.heading: Leveling Guide
sections.text:
- At the end of each raid, blackout both of your legs by jumping off a ledge or by having a friend shoot you. Then perform surgery on both legs.
  - Performing 4 surgeries per raid will result in max-level surgery after 1400 raids.
  - Having a friend shoot your limbs out is an effective way to gain surgery and Vitality simultaneously.
